note: Raised from n=30 to n=100 to get the bound under the smallest gap the board publishes (0.23). Came back at 0.47 not-excluded because the sizing used the per-JUDGE sd where the ensemble drift sd is larger. RESOLUTION (0.27, smallest detectable shift) and NOT-EXCLUDED (0.47, largest drift consistent with the data) are different quantities and the board-safety decision depends on the second.
board_impact: Every adjacent pair on the n=5 board already overlaps on the within-board 95% CI, and the published page states that overlapping intervals are a statistical tie. Drift only widens those intervals, so the existing disclosure is conservative rather than optimistic. No republication required.
what_would_change_it: Any change to the judge panel's composition, the rubrics, or the models behind them. Re-baseline deliberately if the probe catalog digest changes.
